    All Classes and Interfaces

    Class
    Description
    AbandonedShipCard
    Represents a card that allows players to interact with an abandoned ship in the game.
    AbandonedStationCard
    Represents a card that allows players to interact with an abandoned station in the game.
    AbandonRaceCommand
    Represents a command sent from the client to the server to abandon the race.
    AlienColor
    Enumeration representing the available alien colors in the game.
    AlienLifeSupport
    Represents a specialized component which, if attached to the ship next to a cabin, ensures it can contain alien inhabitants.
    AsyncRunner
    The AsyncRunner class provides a utility for executing tasks asynchronously using a single-threaded ExecutorService.
    AsyncRunner.SafeRunnable
    A functional interface similar to Runnable, but allows for methods that can throw Exception.
    AttachComponentCommand
    Represents a command sent from the client to the server to attach a component to a specific position on the ship grid.
    BatteryComponent
    Represents a component with a specific capacity for storing batteries, This class allows for modifications to its current capacity while ensuring it does not exceed its predefined limits.
    Cabin
    Represents a cabin component in the game, capable of holding human crew members or alien inhabitants with specific life support requirements.
    Cannon
    Represents a Cannon component with configurable power and orientation.
    CannonHit
    The CannonHit class represents a cannon hit, which is a game element characterized by specific side and size.
    Card
    Represents a generic card used in the game.
    CardFactory
    CardFactory is responsible for managing and handling a collection of cards used in the game.
    CardManagerController
    Controller for managing card display and player interactions during card resolution phases.
    CardViewAssemble
    Controller for displaying a sub-deck of cards during the assembly phase.
    CargoHold
    Represents a cargo hold component capable of storing goods with specific constraints.
    ClientData
    Represents the client data within the system, managing the association between a client represented by a VirtualView and its corresponding player information.
    ClientModel
    Manages the client-side model, handling game state, player data, and interactions with the UI and server.
    ClientServerCommand
    Represents a command that can be sent from a client to the server.
    ClientState
    Enumeration representing the different states a client can be in during the game.
    CloseStageManager
    Singleton manager for handling the closing of all application stages.
    Color
    Enumeration representing the available colors in the game.
    CombatZoneCard
    Represents a specific card in the game that triggers the "Combat Zone" scenario.
    CommandHandler
    Handles the execution of commands received from the CommandParser.
    CommandParser
    Parses user input commands and dispatches them to the appropriate handler.
    Component
    Represents a general component in the game, serving as the base class for various specialized components.
    ConnectionResponse
    Represents the possible responses to a connection attempt to a game.
    ConnectionResponseCommand
    Represents a command sent from the server to the client as a response to a connection attempt.
    Connector
    Enumeration representing the different types of connectors available in the game.
    Context
    This class is used to make call to setCardContext and applyEffect uniform between all the specific card types.
    ContextValidator
    The ContextValidator class provides static methods to validate and manage the context of card and effect activations within the game.
    Controller
    The Controller class manages player interactions, communication between clients and the server during the game, and some game logic.
    ControllerManager
    The ControllerManager class handles the management of game controllers, client connections, managing the starting and closing of games.
    CreateGameCommand
    Represents a command sent from a client to the server to request the creation of a new game.
    CrewPlacingPhaseCommand
    Represents a command sent from the server to the client to start the crew placing phase.
    CrewSelectionController
    Controller for the crew selection phase of the game.
    CurrentPhase
    The CurrentPhase class represents the current phase of a game.
    Dashboard
    Controller for the main game dashboard during flight phase 1.
    Dashboard2
    Controller for the main game dashboard during flight phase 2.
    Deck
    The Deck class represents a collection of cards used within the game.
    DiceResultCommand
    Represents a command sent from the server to the client to communicate the result of a dice roll.
    DrawCardCommand
    Represents a command sent from the client to the server to draw a new card.
    DrawFaceDownComponentCommand
    Represents a command sent from the client to the server to draw a face-down component.
    DrawFaceUpComponentCommand
    Represents a command sent from the client to the server to draw a specific face-up component.
    DrawFromReservedCommand
    Represents a command sent from the client to the server to draw a component from the reserved components.
    EffectResolutionCommand
    Represents a command sent from the server to the client to put the client in effect resolution state.
    EffectType
    The EffectType enum represents the different types of effects that can be associated with cards in the game.
    EndAssemblePhaseCommand
    Represents a command sent from the client to the server to signal the end of the assemble phase.
    EndCrewPlacingPhaseCommand
    Represents a command sent from the client to the server to signal the end of the crew placing phase for the specified client.
    Engine
    The Engine class represents an engine component that extends the Component class.
    EpidemicCard
    Represents an Epidemic card in the game.
    ExceptionCommand
    Represents a command sent from the server to the client to communicate an exception that occurred on the server-side.
    FinalStageController
    Controller for displaying the final game results and player rankings.
    FinishFinalHourglassCommand
    Represents a command sent from the server to the client to indicate that the final hourglass timer has finished.
    FlightPhaseCommand
    Represents a command sent from the server to the client to start the flight phase of the game.
    Game
    Represents a Galaxy Trucker game session.
    Gameboard
    The Gameboard class represents the board used in the game, containing a specified number of boxes based on the game level.
    GameSelectorController
    Controller for the game selection screen.
    GetFaceUpComponentListCommand
    Represents a command sent from the client to the server to request the list of available face-up components.
    GetSubDeckCommand
    Represents a command sent from the client to the server to request a sub-deck of cards.
    Good
    Enumeration representing different types of goods with their associated values.
    Gui
    Main JavaFX application class that serves as the central controller for the GUI.
    GuiRenderer
    Singleton implementation of the UiRenderer interface for JavaFX-based GUI rendering.
    HourGlass
    Represents a countdown timer with a default duration of 90 seconds.
    IncrementCommand
    Represents a command sent from the client to the server to perform an increment operation, used to keep track of clients' connections.
    JoinGameCommand
    Represents a command sent from a client to the server to request to join an existing game.
    LeaveGameCommand
    Represents a command sent from a client to the server to request to leave the current game.
    LockClientCommand
    Represents a command sent from the server to the client to lock the client's user interface and input.
    Main
     
    MainCabin
    Represents the main cabin component of a spaceship.
    Meteor
    The Meteor class represents a meteor, which is a game element characterized by specific side and size.
    MeteorSwarmCard
    The MeteorSwarmCard class represents a card that reproduces the effect of a meteor swarm in the game.
    NameErrorException
     
    NewLeaderCommand
    Represents a command sent from the server to the client to inform about a change in game leader status.
    NoCardsLeftException
     
    NotifyDefeatCommand
    Represents a command sent from the server to the client to notify them of their defeat.
    OpenSpaceCard
    Represents an "Open Space" card in the game.
    OpponentShipController
    Controller for displaying an opponent's ship in a separate window.
    OrientationShield
    Enumeration representing the four diagonal orientations for shield components.
    Phase
    Enumeration representing the different phases of the game Each phase corresponds to a specific stage in the game lifecycle, from initialization to game completion
    PingCommand
    Represents a command sent from the client to the server to check the connection status.
    PingCommand
    Represents a command sent from the server to the client to test the connection.
    PingErrorException
     
    PiratesCard
    The PiratesCard class represents a card in the game that introduces a pirate encounter.
    PlaceCrewMemberCommand
    Represents a command sent from the client to the server to place a crew member or an alien of a specific color on a cabin in a specified position.
    PlaceRocketCommand
    Represents a command sent from the client to the server to place the player's rocket at a specific position.
    PlanetsCard
    The PlanetsCard class represents a card in the game that allows a player to interact with different planets and collect goods from them while losing some days of travel.
    Player
    Represents a player in a game, identified by a unique ID and nickname, with associated game-specific objects like a rocket and a ship.
    PlayerJoinedCommand
    Represents a command sent from the server to the client to notify about a new player joining the game.
    PutDownComponentCommand
    Represents a command sent from the client to the server to put down a component.
    RemoveComponentCommand
    Represents a command sent from the client to the server to remove a component from a specific position.
    RmiClient
    The RmiClient class represents the client-side implementation for RMI communication in the application.
    RmiServer
    The RmiServer class is an implementation of the VirtualServer interface, extending UnicastRemoteObject.
    Rocket
    Represents a player's rocket on the game's gameboard, which can be assigned a color and position.
    RollDiceCommand
    Represents a command sent from the client to the server to request a dice roll.
    RoundResultCommand
    Represents a command sent from the server to the client to notify the result of a round during specific cards' effect application.
    SelectedTileController
    Controller for managing the selected component tile during the ship assembly phase.
    ServerClientCommand
    Represents a command that can be sent from the server to a client.
    SetCardContextCommand
    Represents a command sent from the client to the server to perform some action before applying a card's effect.
    SetEffectContextCommand
    Represents a command sent from the client to the server to set contextual information and to apply the current card's effect.
    SetGameLevelCommand
    Represents a command sent from the client to the server to set the game level or difficulty.
    SetGameLevelCommand
    Represents a command sent from the server to the client to set the game level.
    SetMaxPlayersCommand
    Represents a command sent from the client to the server to set the maximum number of players for a game.
    SetNicknameCommand
    Represents a command sent from the client to the server to set the client's nickname.
    SetNicknameCommand
    Represents a command sent from the server to the client to prompt the client to set its nickname.
    SetUuidCommand
    Represents a command sent from the server to the client to set the client's UUID.
    SharedRmiSocket
    The SharedRmiSocket class is responsible for starting both RMI and Socket servers.
    ShieldGenerator
    Represents a shield generator component that can protect specific sides of the spaceship.
    Ship
    Represents a player's spaceship in the game, managing components placement, grid layout, combat mechanics, and ship validation.
    ShowCardCommand
    Represents a command sent from the server to the client to display a specific card.
    ShowComponentCommand
    Represents a command sent from the server to the client to display a specific ship component.
    ShowFaceUpComponentListCommand
    Represents a command sent from the server to the client to display a list of face-up components.
    ShowFinalRankingCommand
    Represents a command sent from the server to the client to display the final ranking of players.
    ShowGameListCommand
    Represents a command sent from the server to the client to display a list of available games.
    ShowSecondsLeftCommand
    Represents a command sent from the server to the client to display the remaining seconds for an hourglass timer.
    ShowSecondsLeftForGuiCommand
    Represents a command sent from the server to the client (specifically for GUI) to display the remaining seconds for an hourglass timer.
    ShowShipCommand
    Represents a command sent from the client to the server to request a certain player's updated ship.
    ShowShipCommand
    Represents a command sent from the server to the client to display a specific ship.
    ShowSubDeckCommand
    Represents a command sent from the server to the client to display a sub-deck of cards.
    ShowUpdateCommand
    Represents a command sent from the server to the client to display a general update message.
    Side
    Enumeration representing the four cardinal sides or directions.
    Size
    The Size enum represents the size of a game element.
    SlaversCard
    The SlaversCard class represents a card in the game that introduces slavers encounter.
    SmugglersCard
    The PiratesCard class represents a card in the game that introduces smugglers encounter.
    SocketClient
    The SocketClient class represents the client-side implementation for Socket communication in the application.
    SocketClientHandler
    The SocketClientHandler class is a server-side component responsible for managing the communication with a single connected client in a socket-based network environment.
    SocketServer
    The SocketServer class represents a server that listens for client connections, manages them, and delegates their requests to the ControllerManager for processing.
    SocketServerHandler
    The SocketServerHandler class acts as a client-side proxy for the server in a socket-based communication.
    Stage2Controller
    Controller for the ship assembly phase (Stage 2) of the game.
    StardustCard
    Represents the stardust card in the game, a specific type of card that applies an effect where a player's rocket moves back based on the number of exposed connectors on their ship.
    StartAssemblingPhaseCommand
    Represents a command sent from the server to the client to start the assembling phase of the game.
    StartFinalHourGlassCommand
    Represents a command sent from the client to the server to start the final hourglass timer.
    StartGameCommand
    Represents a command sent from the server to the client to signal the start of the game.
    StartHourGlassCommand
    Represents a command sent from the client to the server to initiate an hourglass timer.
    Tiles
    The Tiles class represents a collection of components used within the game.
    TuiRenderer
    TuiRenderer is an implementation of the UiRenderer interface that provides a Text-based User Interface (TUI) for the game.
    TurnChangeCommand
    Represents a command sent from the server to the client to notify a change in turn.
    UiRenderer
    This interface defines the methods for any User Interface (UI) in the application.
    UpdateHandler
    The UpdateHandler class provides static methods to manage and dispatch game updates to connected clients.
    UpdateMessage
    The UpdateMessage enum represents a set of predefined messages that are used to communicate the status of a game-related event to a client.
    UpdatePositionsCommand
    Represents a command sent from the server to the client to update players' positions.
    ViewGameCommand
    Represents a command sent from the client to the server to request to view the list of available games.
    VirtualServer
    This interface defines the methods for server-side operations that can be invoked remotely by a client.
    VirtualView
    This interface defines the methods for client-side display and input operations that can be remotely invoked by the server.
    WaitingRoomController
    Controller for the waiting room between game phases.
